notes: Bundled router-agent fixes built on top of v0.4.7 (pre-rebrand base): LAN-phone bridge (br-phone) NetworkManager conflict fix, bandwidth shaping LAN-to-LAN bypass, and hiding agent-managed virtual interfaces from the interfaces list. Supersedes v0.4.9 as the recommended build until that rebrand issue is resolved.
